description: Unofficial CatNap fan-art companion based on the friendly compact Smiling Critters cartoon toy from Poppy Playtime. Original gentle animations include fluffing a pillow and curling up, tidying crescent cards with a curved tail, cuddling a soft star, a four-paw hop and articulated toy-cat runs. No horror transformation, smoke, hypnosis or harm. Not official or endorsed.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
